subject: MAP & exchange runway: evaluation dataset + prompt pack handoff
messages:
From: Lisa Carter <lisa@retailco.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: data-team@retailco.com
Date: 2025-08-14T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation exchange: sample dataset + promptpack request

Diego —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to run a short eval using Redwood on a bounded subset of our retail QA cases. Before we hand anything over, we need a mutual action plan (MAP) that covers:
- exact assets to be exchanged (testcases, prompt packs, sample logs)
- acceptance criteria and pass/fail gates
- usage constraints (no persistent storage except sandbox, no external sharing)
- retention & destruction timelines

Can you share your typical MAP template and a proposed close timeline? Goal: complete exchange and 2-week run by end of September.

Lisa
Lisa Carter
Head of Data Platforms — RetailCo

From: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa@retailco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation exchange: sample dataset + promptpack request

Lisa —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Attached is a preliminary MAP (MPA_RetailCo_v0.1.pdf) that mirrors what other retail pilots use. High level:
1) Assets: 10k masked testcases (read-only sandbox), promptpack_v2 (zipped prompts + metadata), and a 100-case quick smoke harness.
2) Acceptance: precision/recall thresholds on labeled holdout; smoke harness must pass 90% of control cases.
3) Usage constraints: sandbox-only, tokenized logs retained for 30 days, output artifacts exported only with explicit consent.
4) Timeline: sign-off within 10 business days -> ingestion -> 14-day evaluation window -> close/cleanup.

Attachments: MPA_RetailCo_v0.1.pdf (MAP draft). I copied Marissa to help with acceptance criteria and ingest details; Karthik will own contract/sla items.

Propose a 30-minute call Thurs to walk the plan and nail dates — does 2025-08-20 10:00 PDT work?

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: MPA_RetailCo_v0.1.pdf (3 pages, draft)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa@retailco.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation exchange: sample dataset + promptpack request

Lisa / team —

Thanks — a couple practical notes from the ingestion side:
- Prompt pack format: we expect prompts as a CSV with prompt_id, prompt_text, metadata.json for provenance. If you can provide promptpack_v2.zip with that layout, ingestion is much faster.
- Masking checklist: remove PII, keep canonical IDs to map to holdout. We can run a quick PII scan and share a report before ingest.
- Sandbox access: we'll provision ephemeral API keys tied to your account; logs are only accessible to people on the MAP.

I've attached a sample prompt pack (promptpack_v2.zip) skeleton and a short acceptance matrix below. Please review the acceptance metrics and let us know if any business KPIs should be added.

Acceptance matrix (excerpt):
- Holdout size: 2k labeled cases
- Primary metric: top-1 accuracy >= 0.82
- Secondary: F1 on intent classification >= 0.78

On the call we can walk tool-level constraints (no token retention beyond 30 days unless agreed).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Program Manager, Trials — Redwood Inference

Attachment: promptpack_v2.zip (skeleton, 1.2 MB stub)

From: RetailCo Data Team <data-team@retailco.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-18T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation exchange: sample dataset + promptpack request

Diego / Marissa —

Following up from our side after an internal review. A few hard constraints from legal/security:
- No persistent copies outside the provisioned sandbox; logs must be rotated and deleted after 30 days.
- Testcases must be delivered via SFTP or a signed Drive share link; no email attachments for the dataset.
- Prompt packs are fine as zipped artifacts, but we require a hash manifest and provenance metadata (who authored which prompt).

We can provide an initial 2k holdout this week if the MAP includes a clause for destruction (certificate required) and an audit window for 60 days. Also want to confirm export rules: exports of model outputs to RetailCo-only destinations are allowed; exports to third-party services require additional approvals.

If you can update the MAP with the SFTP/Drive deliverable and the destruction certificate step, we should be able to sign off quickly.

—Lisa (on behalf of RetailCo Data Team)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa@retailco.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation exchange: sample dataset + promptpack request

Lisa —

Thanks for the constraints — we can meet those. I've updated the MAP to include:
- Deliverables & transfer method: SFTP credentialed drop or restricted Drive link; manifest and SHA256 hashes required.
- Retention/destruction: 30-day automated log retention; dataset destruction certificate issued within 10 business days of agreed takedown.
- Audit window: Redwood will retain minimal audit logs for 60 days for compliance and provide a redacted certificate on request.
- Exports: default to RetailCo destinations only; any third-party export requires written approval from RetailCo legal.

Attached: MAP-RetailCo-20250814.docx (updated), SLA-exchange.csv (tokenization & throughput estimates). Proposed close timeline:
- 2025-08-21: final MAP review & DocuSign send
- 2025-08-25: dataset transfer (SFTP)
- 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-14: evaluation window
- 2025-09-16: final review & certificate of destruction issued by 2025-09-23 if agreed

If that timeline looks good I'll send the DocuSign link and calendar invite.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-RetailCo-20250814.docx (rev A), SLA-exchange.csv (calc sheet)

From: Lisa Carter <lisa@retailco.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation exchange: sample dataset + promptpack request

Karthik / team —

This looks good and aligns with legal's guidance. We are green to:
- sign the updated MAP once DocuSign arrives
- provide the 2k holdout to your SFTP on 2025-08-25
- run the evaluation 2025-09-01 -> 2025-09-14

Please send the DocuSign link and calendar invite for the kickoff (use the calendar link in the doc). Karthik — please ensure the destruction cert template is attached to the DocuSign envelope so we can close the loop.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Lisa
